page.content:
Long argument over how high the notability bar should sit.

How Deletionism and inclusionism connects

  • Topic: Notability — Notability guidelines are the usual ground of deletionist and inclusionist fights.

What is Deletionism and inclusionism?

Deletionists favor strict notability and pruning; inclusionists favor keeping sourced stubs. The split is a standing culture war inside the same Five pillars.

Key threads lead to Notability.
